title: Genesis 22:12 — Do not stretch out your hand; now I know you fear God
summary: The Akedah: Genesis 22:12 in English and Hebrew. The angel says not to harm the lad because now he knows Abraham fears God, since he has not withheld his son, his only son. The word את (et) is shown before 'your son' and 'your only son' (red-underlined with the matching Hebrew); 'now' is underlined in blue, and the words He, Me and God have coloured letters.

text.text: 12 He said, “Do not stretch out your hand against the lad, and do nothing to him; for now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld את your son, את your only son, from Me.”
12 ויאמר אל־תשלח ידך אל־הנער ואל־תעש לו מאומה כי ׀ עתה ידעתי כי־ירא אלהים אתה ולא חשכת את־בנך את־יחידך ממני׃

words.gloss: alef-tav; untranslated direct-object marker before your son and your only son
